ConditionalCloseOrder.title: ConditionalCloseOrder
ConditionalCloseOrder.description: A conditional close order attached to a primary order.

WsConditionalCloseOrder.title: WsConditionalCloseOrder
WsConditionalCloseOrder.description: Template for the secondary close order generated on each fill of the primary order (One-Triggers-Other). The secondary order matches the executed quantity and takes the opposite side.

order_type.description: Order type of the secondary close order created on each fill.

limit_price.description: Limit price on the secondary close order. Required for secondary order types that support a limit price: `limit`, `stop-loss-limit`, `take-profit-limit`.

limit_price_type.description: Units for `limit_price` on the secondary order. Only available on trailing-stop-limit orders; for that order type the value is an offset from the trigger price (`0` sets the limit price equal to the trigger price).

trigger_price.description: Amount for the trigger price on the secondary close order -- static or relative, per `trigger_price_type`. Required on triggered secondary order types: `stop-loss`, `stop-loss-limit`, `take-profit`, `take-profit-limit`.

trigger_price_type.description: Units for `trigger_price` on the secondary order.

stop_price.description: Deprecated -- use `trigger_price`. Trigger price on the secondary close order, for triggered secondary order types.

OrderTriggers.title: OrderTriggers
OrderTriggers.description: Trigger price conditions for triggered order types.

reference.description: Reference price to track for triggering orders: `index` (the broader-market index price for this pair -- falls back to `last` during index-feed connectivity issues) or `last` (the last traded price in the Kraken order book for this pair).

price.description: Amount for the trigger price -- static or relative, per `price_type`. E.g. 29000.5 with `price_type=static` triggers at that price; 5 with `pct` triggers when price rises 5%; -150 with `quote` triggers when price drops 150 quote-currency units. For `trailing-stop`/`trailing-stop-limit`, represents the reversion from the peak price and is always positive.

price_type.description: Units for `price`: `static` (a static market price), `pct` (a percentage offset from the reference price), or `quote` (a notional offset in the quote currency).
